name: agent-sandbox
description: A read-only cloud sandbox for Claude Code: provisions a non-admin macOS identity with a per-user AWS IAM role (ReadOnlyAccess + targeted denies), read-only Kubernetes access entries, and credential-broker access to GitHub, MongoDB and Snowflake, all reached through pinned argless mint brokers so secrets never sit in the sandbox or pass through the model; sweeps AWS surfaces reachable from that identity for plaintext credentials, reporting locations only, never values; and deletes the sandbox when it's no longer needed.
